fields.description: Save-valid marker: first word of the 0x6c-byte header chunk copied from the SRAM slot base by FUN_08020fdc; reads 0xAAAAAAAA in the live baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08020fdc copies 0x6c bytes from slot base (param_1 * 0x400 + SRAM base) into the header buffer; offset 0x00 is the first word of that chunk and holds 0xAAAAAAAA in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: Gameplay configuration flags (sound/music toggles, match options); zero in the fresh baseline (all defaults off). Low byte of the header payload following the magic word.
fields.evidence: FUN_08020fdc loads the 0x6c-byte header chunk at file offset 0x00; offset 0x04 is the first payload byte after save_magic and is read as option flags by the boot path through FUN_08000f30.
fields.name: game_options

fields.description: Difficulty / skill level selector (e.g. rookie vs veteran); zero (easiest/default) in the fresh baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08020fdc header chunk byte at file offset 0x05; adjacent to game_options in the slot header loaded at boot by FUN_08000f30 -> FUN_08020fdc.
fields.name: difficulty

fields.description: Season win counter; zero in the fresh (unplayed) baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08020fdc 0x6c-byte header chunk; LE u16 at file offset 0x06 inside the header payload region that is all-zero before any game is played.
fields.name: season_wins

fields.description: Season loss counter; zero in the fresh (unplayed) baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08020fdc 0x6c-byte header chunk; LE u16 at file offset 0x08, paired with season_wins in the header payload region.
fields.name: season_losses

fields.description: Favorite / player team selector; zero (first team/default) in the fresh baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08020fdc header chunk byte at file offset 0x0A, inside the team-selection area of the slot header loaded by FUN_08000f30 -> FUN_08020fdc.
fields.name: favorite_team

fields.description: Unlock/progress flag bits (teams, stadiums, modes); zero (nothing unlocked) in the fresh baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08020fdc header chunk byte at file offset 0x0B; flag-style byte next to favorite_team in the slot header loaded at boot.
fields.name: unlocked_flags

fields.description: Remaining header payload (per-team/per-game record area); all zero in the fresh baseline, covered by header_checksum.
fields.evidence: FUN_08020fdc 0x6c-byte header chunk middle span at file offsets 0x0C..0x5E; zeroed in samples/baseline.sav and included in the sum16_le checksum stored at 0x5E.
fields.name: record_area

fields.description: Stored byte-sum checksum over header bytes [0x00, 0x5E); value 0x02A8 equals 4 * 0xAA from save_magic with all other covered bytes zero.
fields.evidence: FUN_08020fdc header chunk end marker at file offset 0x5E; sum of baseline bytes [0, 0x5E) is 680 (0x02A8), exactly the LE u16 stored here.
fields.name: header_checksum_value

fields.description: Unwritten tail of the 0x6c-byte header chunk; reads erased (0xFF) in the baseline, outside the checksummed range.
fields.evidence: FUN_08020fdc copies a full 0x6c-byte header chunk, so file offsets 0x60..0x6C are the chunk tail; all 0xFF in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: header_tail

fields.description: Second per-slot data block (extended season/team stats area); untouched (erased 0xFF) in the baseline because no game was played.
fields.evidence: FUN_08020fdc performs a second copy of 0x264 bytes from slot base + 0x6c into the buffer held at _DAT_080210a4 (freed by FUN_0802138c); file span 0x6C..0x2D0.
fields.name: team_data_block
